title: On Thy Church, O Power Divine
description: On Thy Church, O Power Divine in Tonic Solfa to RATISBON (WERNER), doh is D: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 2 verses and a piano.
about: These words were printed without an author's name in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 308 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “Glory of the Church”, where the book credits them to the Spirit of the Psalms.

The book printed the words without tunes, marked Sevens, six lines (7.7.7.7.7.7), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to RATISBON (WERNER); any other Sevens, six lines tune fits them as well.
underlay: On thy church, O Power Di-vine, Cause thy glo-rious face to shine; Till the na-tions from a-far Hail her as their gui-ding star; Till her sons, from zone to zone, Make thy great sal-va-tion known.

lines: On thy church, O Power Divine,
Cause thy glorious face to shine;
Hail her as their guiding star;
Till her sons, from zone to zone,
Then shall God, with lavish hand,
Earth shall yield her rich increase,
With the voice of praise resound.

licence: Public domain: anonymous words in print by 1853.
credits: Words anonymous, public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to RATISBON (WERNER) by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
